prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: Displayed the workspace credit history (when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds) under the credit balance on the Settings page in both English and Korean.

check.why: failed AI calls cost nothing, history lists charges and refunds, shown in Settings in both languages, tests and changelog

+import base64
+import uuid
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini, PNG
+
+
+def _get_workspace(client, headers) -> dict:
+    workspaces = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=headers).json()
+    return workspaces[0]
+
+
+def _get_credits(client, headers) -> int:
+    return _get_workspace(client, headers)["credits"]
+
+
+def _create_project_and_character(client, headers):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/projects",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"title": "Starlight", "genres": [], "style_preset": "Webtoon"},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    project = r.json()
+
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/characters",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "name": "Aria",
+            "project_id": project["id"],
+            "appearance_tags": ["silver hair"],
+            "default_mood": ["calm"],
+            "description": "A mage",
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    character = r.json()
+    return project, character
+
+
+def test_failed_project_cover_does_not_charge_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project, _ = _create_project_and_character(client, h)
+    assert _get_credits(client, h) == 500
+
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    proj_detail = client.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert proj_detail["cover_image_status"] == "failed"
+    assert _get_credits(client, h) == 500
+
+    # Succeeds when Gemini is healthy
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    proj_detail = client.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert proj_detail["cover_image_status"] == "completed"
+    assert _get_credits(client, h) == 485
+
+
+def test_failed_character_sheet_does_not_charge_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _, character = _create_project_and_character(client, h)
+    assert _get_credits(client, h) == 500
+
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/characters/{character['id']}/generate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    char_detail = client.get(f"/api/v1/characters/{character['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert char_detail["sheet_status"] == "failed"
+    assert _get_credits(client, h) == 500
+
+    # Succeeds when Gemini is healthy
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/characters/{character['id']}/generate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    char_detail = client.get(f"/api/v1/characters/{character['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert char_detail["sheet_status"] == "completed"
+    assert _get_credits(client, h) == 480
+
+
+def test_failed_style_generation_and_regeneration_do_not_charge_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    assert _get_credits(client, h) == 500
+
+    FakeGemini.fail = True

+    # Regenerate also fails -> still 500 credits
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/styles/{style_id}/regenerate", headers=h)

+    styles = client.get("/api/v1/styles", headers=h).json()
+    assert styles[0]["status"] == "failed"
+    assert _get_credits(client, h) == 500
+
+    # Regenerate succeeds -> charges 10 credits
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/styles/{style_id}/regenerate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    styles = client.get("/api/v1/styles", headers=h).json()
+    assert styles[0]["status"] == "completed"
+    assert _get_credits(client, h) == 490
+
+
+def test_failed_sync_ai_endpoints_do_not_charge_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project, _ = _create_project_and_character(client, h)
+    pid = project["id"]
+    b64_png = f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(PNG).decode('utf-8')}"
+
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+
+    calls = [
+        ("/api/v1/projects/worldview/augment", {"description": "A floating city", "title": "Sky"}),
+        ("/api/v1/projects/styles/recommend", {"description": "Dark fantasy"}),
+        ("/api/v1/characters/augment", {"project_id": pid, "name": "Aria", "tags": ["mage"], "mood": ["calm"]}),
+        ("/api/v1/characters/suggest", {"project_id": pid, "type": "name"}),
+        ("/api/v1/characters/analyze", {"project_id": pid, "name": "Aria", "age": "20", "visual_keywords": ["mage"], "personality": "calm"}),
+        ("/api/v1/characters/suggestions/batch", {"project_id": pid}),
+        ("/api/v1/scenes/structure", {"script": "Aria enters the hall", "project_id": pid}),
+        ("/api/v1/scenes/modify", {"original_image_url": b64_png, "instruction": "Add rain", "project_id": pid}),
+        ("/api/v1/scenes/render", {"prompt": "A castle at night", "project_id": pid}),
+        (f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/characters/casting/augment", {"name": "Aria", "tags": ["mage"], "mood": "calm", "style": "Webtoon"}),
+        (f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/episodes/ideas", {"project_id": pid}),
+        (f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/episodes/create", {"project_id": pid, "title": "Ep 1", "summary": "Beginning", "num_cuts": 2}),
+    ]
+
+    for path, payload in calls:
+        r = client.post(path, headers=h, json=payload)
+        assert r.status_code >= 500, f"Expected failure for {path}, got {r.status_code}"
+        assert _get_credits(client, h) == 500, f"Credits were charged on failed call to {path}"

+    h = signup(client)
+    project, character = _create_project_and_character(client, h)
+    pid = project["id"]
+    cid = character["id"]
+
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/art-style", headers=h, json={"art_style": "Watercolor"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()["cover_image_status"] == "failed"
+    assert _get_credits(client, h) == 500
+
+    r = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/characters/casting/generate",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"character_id": cid, "name": "Aria", "description": "A mage", "style": "Watercolor"},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/characters/{cid}", headers=h).json()["sheet_status"] == "failed"
+    assert _get_credits(client, h) == 500
+
+
+def test_insufficient_credits_rejected_before_ai_call(client):
+    from sqlmodel import Session
+    from uuid import UUID
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models.models import Workspace
+
+    h = signup(client)
+    project, _ = _create_project_and_character(client, h)
+    ws_id = UUID(_get_workspace(client, h)["id"])
+
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        ws = session.get(Workspace, ws_id)
+        ws.credits = 2
+        session.add(ws)
+        session.commit()
+
+    FakeGemini.calls.clear()
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 402
+    assert r.json()["code"] == "PAYMENT_INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS"
+    assert FakeGemini.calls == []
+    assert _get_credits(client, h) == 2
+
+
+def test_workspace_credit_history_includes_charges_refunds_and_refills_newest_first(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws_id = _get_workspace(client, h)["id"]
+    project, character = _create_project_and_character(client, h)
+
+    # 1. Trigger daily refill (+50)
+    r = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws_id}", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["credits"] == 550
+
+    # 2. Successful cover generation (-15)
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert _get_credits(client, h) == 535
+
+    # 3. Failed character sheet generation (-20 then +20 refund)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/characters/{character['id']}/generate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert _get_credits(client, h) == 535
+
+    # 4. Fetch credit history
+    r = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws_id}/credits/history", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    history = r.json()
+
+    assert len(history) == 4
+    for item in history:
+        assert "amount" in item
+        assert "action" in item
+        assert "created_at" in item
+
+    # Newest first: refund (+20), refunded charge (-20), successful cover charge (-15), daily refill (+50)
+    assert [item["amount"] for item in history] == [20, -20, -15, 50]
+    assert history[3]["action"] == "daily_refill"
+    assert history[2]["action"] == "generate_project_cover_image"
+    assert history[1]["action"] == "generate_character_sheet"
+    assert "refund" in history[0]["action"]
+
+    # Timestamps are strictly descending
+    timestamps = [item["created_at"] for item in history]
+    assert timestamps == sorted(timestamps, reverse=True)
+
